sources.entry: Pinchflat ⚠ - Download YouTube content built using yt-dlp. AGPL-3.0 Docker
Pinchflat | YouTube media manager that downloads new content automatically

summary.one_liner: Pinchflat is a self-hosted app that automatically downloads content from YouTube channels and playlists using yt-dlp, saving it to disk for media center apps.
summary.what_it_does: You set up rules for downloading from YouTube channels or playlists, and the app periodically checks for new content and downloads it. It is designed to be lightweight and self-contained, shipped as a single Docker container with a web interface and presets. Downloads go to disk so they can be watched in Plex, Jellyfin, Kodi, or VLC rather than in the app itself. It can also serve RSS feeds for podcast apps, download audio-only content, and integrate with SponsorBlock and Apprise notifications. Individual videos can be downloaded, but the README says it is best suited to channels and playlists. Advanced options include custom yt-dlp options, cookies for private playlists, cutoff dates, title filters, and automatic deletion of old content.
use_cases: Automatically download new videos from YouTube channels
Archive YouTube playlists to local disk
Build a Plex, Jellyfin, or Kodi library from YouTube content
Turn YouTube channels into podcast RSS feeds
Download private playlists using browser cookies
how_to_run: Alternatively, install from the Unraid Community Apps store or use the Portainer/Docker Compose file in the README
Open the web interface on port 8945
notable: Built on yt-dlp with a claimed novel approach for quickly detecting new uploads
Single Docker container with no external dependencies
Supports Plex, Jellyfin, and Kodi naming and layout, plus RSS feeds for podcast apps
Optional Prometheus metrics and Podman rootless setup documented
caveats: README states the software is in active development and anything can break; no stability guarantees
Not intended for in-app viewing; content must be watched through a media center app or VLC
Users getting IP-limited may need to lower YT_DLP_WORKER_CONCURRENCY to 1
Config on network shares requires changing SQLite journal mode, with possible data loss if switched on an existing instance
